body_lead: Bhubaneswar: Odisha govt on Wednesday cleared investment proposals worth Rs 2.47 lakh crore across 27 projects in 15 districts, with ventures expected to generate over 50,000 jobs and deepen the stateâs push into new-age sectors such as data centres, artificial intelligence (AI), semiconductors and green energy. The proposals, approved at the 46th meeting of the high-level clearance authority (HLCA) chaired by chief minister Mohan Charan Majhi, entail a cumulative investment of Rs 2,47,115.70 crore and are projected to create 50,162 employment opportunities.
